justification: Both show a single standing human figure in profile relief, arms extended forward with hands apparently gripping a vertical object, the body clothed in a robe whose folds are rendered as fine parallel incised lines. A shares far more legible detail (crenellated headdress, elaborately curled beard and hair, a spear and a slung bow-case) whereas B preserves only the torso, arms and a fragment of a headdress/hair mass, so the specific attributes that would confirm a shared scheme are largely absent.
